title: Finite-dispersion temperature corrections in stationary quartic-superluminal Hawking scattering
description: Article (version 1.2) with stored results and code. For a stationary one-dimensional flow with quartic superluminal dispersion and a single horizon, the low-frequency limit of the ratio temperature is reduced to a zero-frequency problem, and a formal expansion gives the relative offset kappa g'''(0)/(12 Lambda^2), where g expresses v' as a function of 1+v. The result is conditional on stated assumptions (A1-A3) that are not proved; it is supported by stage-wise numerical checks, a prediction-first test and an independent numerical computation on four profiles. The frequency-curvature coefficient is compared over 19 profiles with a known phase-integral formula. No human expert review. Text and data: CC BY 4.0; code: Apache 2.0.
